logline: Short horror stories told to YOU, in 4 parts. Every part ends on a choice. The comments choose. Pick wrong and the story gets worse.

format.pov: Second person, present/past tense: 'Every night at 3:17, your doorbell rings.'
structure: Part 1: the hook + the rule/the wrongness + first choice.
Part 2: opens with the vote result ('62% of you opened the door.'), consequence, escalation, second choice.
Part 3: the twist (something the viewer assumed is wrong), third choice.
Part 4 (FINAL): the ending caused by the votes, then a quick 'what if' montage of what the other choices would have done, then tease the next story.
format.narration_style: Calm, close, creepy. Short sentences. One keyword per sentence wrapped in *asterisks* (shown in green). End each part on dread.
format.caption_rule: Mark exactly one keyword per sentence with *word*.

voices._note: Deep, close horror narrator: blend of am_fenrir (expressive) with am_onyx (deep). Never add echo/reverb to voices.

voting_rules.how: Each comment counts as one vote for the first option it clearly names (option keyword, label, or the letter A/B). Most-liked comments break ties. Report the split as a percentage at the start of the next part.
voting_rules.no_votes: If fewer than 10 votes, pick the option that makes the better story and say 'the few of you who voted chose...'.
voting_rules.cameos: If a commenter asks to be in the story ('I'd be the neighbor'), they can appear as a background character named by their handle on a sign/phone screen. Same safety rules as the other channels.

scene_types.bg: bedroom | hallway | door | doorcam | black (add new ones in render/players/horror.js as stories need them)
scene_types.figure: {pose: stand|phone|walk|scared, x, y, s, hood}: the viewer's stick-figure self
scene_types.visitor: doorcam: none|far|close|you ; door: any value shows feet under the door
scene_types.sfx: doorbell, knock, heartbeat, boom, glitch, whoosh, tick, riser, click
scene_types.flash: true = white flash at scene start (jump cut)

safety_rules: Creepy, not gory. No graphic violence, no self-harm, no real people or places, nothing sexual.
No content targeting any group. Monsters are original.
story_backlog: THE 3:17 VISITOR: your doorbell rings at 3:17 every night; tonight the camera shows someone wearing your clothes.
THE SECOND SHADOW: your shadow starts moving a half-second late.
UNIT 4B: the apartment listing was too cheap. The previous tenant left a list of rules on the fridge.
THE LAST BUS: the night bus driver says 'this is your stop' at a street that doesn't exist.
MOM'S VOICEMAIL: you get a voicemail from your mom telling you not to come home. She's in the kitchen.
THE GAME CABINET: an arcade machine with your initials already on the high score list.
THE BABYSITTING JOB: the parents left one rule: don't answer if the kid calls from upstairs. The kid is in your lap.
